name: Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP
description: Disables NetBIOS over TCP/IP to reduce legacy broadcast traffic and improve security on modern systems. This change may affect compatibility with older file shares, NAS devices, or workgroup discovery.

description_i18n.en: Disables NetBIOS over TCP/IP to reduce legacy broadcast traffic and improve security on modern systems. This change may affect compatibility with older file shares, NAS devices, or workgroup discovery.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert NetBIOS über TCP/IP, um Legacy-Broadcast-Traffic zu reduzieren und die Sicherheit auf modernen Systemen zu verbessern. Dies kann die Kompatibilität mit älteren Dateifreigaben oder Workgroups beeinträchtigen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive NetBIOS sur TCP/IP pour réduire le trafic broadcast hérité et améliorer la sécurité des systèmes modernes. Cela peut affecter les anciens partages de fichiers ou la découverte en groupe de travail.

warnings.title: Legacy compatibility impact
warnings.message: This change may affect old file shares, older NAS devices, or workgroup discovery. Some network interfaces might to fully apply the setting

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the NetbiosOptions DWORD value under HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters\Interfaces to set it to 2, which disables legacy name resolution
